DeliveryOrder.title: DeliveryOrder
DeliveryOrder.description: Cross-device customer parcel delivery order synced between Customer, Rider, and Admin apps.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the customer who created the order.

paymentMethod.description: Customer checkout payment method (no customer wallet).

assignedRiderUid.description: Optional Firebase UID of assigned rider.

pickupProofNote.description: Optional pickup OTP and camera proof metadata.

deliveryProofNote.description: Optional delivery OTP and camera proof metadata.

riderLat.description: Optional live GPS latitude of the assigned rider.

riderLng.description: Optional live GPS longitude of the assigned rider.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RiderWallet.title: RiderWallet
RiderWallet.description: Rider partner wallet tracking 80/20 earnings, ₹150 (15000 paise) commission debt limit, work mode, and battery health.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the rider.

balancePaise.description: Rider wallet balance in paise (may not fall below -15000).

commissionDebtPaise.description: Outstanding 20% commission owed to company in paise (0 to 500000).

maxCommissionDebtPaise.description: Enforced maximum commission debt threshold in paise (15000 = ₹150).

batteryPercent.description: Latest device battery percentage reported by PowerManager.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CompanyLedgerDoc.title: CompanyLedgerDoc
CompanyLedgerDoc.description: Immutable server-side company wallet ledger entry for gateway collections, commissions, repayments, and bank settlements.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the actor recording the verified ledger entry.

referenceId.description: Order ID, Gateway Payment ID, or Settlement UTR.

isCredit.description: True if credit to company ledger, false if debit.

OrderChatMessage.title: OrderChatMessage
OrderChatMessage.description: Real-time chat message exchanged between the customer and the assigned rider during an active delivery order.

senderUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the message sender (customer or assigned rider).

senderRole.description: Role of the sender in the delivery order.

senderName.description: Display name of the customer or assigned rider sending the message.

messageText.description: Chat message body text (1 to 500 characters).

deliveryStage.description: Optional order status stage when the message was sent.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile (Customer, Rider, or Admin) with strict role immutability and owner-only access.

id.description: Authenticated user UID matching the document ID.

name.description: Sanitized user display name (2 to 80 chars).

role.description: Bound user role; non-admins can only create CUSTOMER or RIDER profiles and cannot self-escalate.

profilePhotoUrl.description: Optional profile photo data URL or HTTPS image URL.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 or server timestamp of last profile update.

RemoteConfigDoc.title: RemoteConfigDoc
RemoteConfigDoc.description: Admin-controlled global feature flags including future B2B postpaid, Razorpay Route split, and auto-KYC switches.

b2bPostpaidEnabled.description: Future rollout switch for B2B / Dukaan monthly postpaid billing (default false).

razorpayRouteSplitEnabled.description: Automated Razorpay Route 80/20 split switch (default false).

autoKycApiEnabled.description: Automated DigiLocker/DL KYC verification switch (default false).

updatedByEmail.description: Email of the Admin who pushed the config update.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest config update.

B2bDukaanAccount.title: B2bDukaanAccount
B2bDukaanAccount.description: Dukaan / Business monthly postpaid credit account gated behind Admin B2B feature toggle.

ownerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the Dukaan owner.

status.description: Admin approval status for monthly postpaid billing.

approvedCreditLimitInr.description: Credit limit approved by Admin in INR (0 until approved).

usedCreditPaise.description: Current outstanding postpaid balance in paise.

totalBilledOrders.description: Count of orders billed to the monthly postpaid ledger.

gstInvoiceNumber.description: Current monthly consolidated GST invoice reference.

lastSettledEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when Admin last marked monthly bill settled.

/delivery_orders/{orderId}/chat_messages.description: Real-time chat messages between the order customer and the assigned rider.

/rider_wallets/{riderUid}.description: Per-rider wallet, commission debt, shift mode, and battery telemetry.

/user_profiles/{userId}.description: Per-user profile document locked to the authenticated owner and protected against role escalation.

/remote_config/{configId}.description: Global Admin feature switches persisted permanently in Cloud Firestore.

/b2b_accounts/{accountId}.description: B2B / Dukaan monthly postpaid credit accounts managed by Admin.
